# One-time Windows signing-format probe

This is a packaging fixture, not the Pikachu game installer. It contains no retail Pokemon assets and no private key. Its test-only certificate was issued on 2026-10-31 for three days; this branch preserves the result of that one-time compatibility check.

The payload comes from Microsoft's MSIX SDK pack fixture at commit 25a65f5c1690930813bcc10cdf1d59fa865f2bb1, with the publisher changed to the self-signed test subject and a synthetic file testing literal dollar/percent names. The catalog fixture comes from osslsigncode at 868d6e95c603a8057e89336f12fe12b5d2258e00. Their license files are included.

The package was generated by the MSIX SDK on Linux, its catalog re-signed and appended by the private packaging helper, then signed using osslsigncode. This checks Microsoft's acceptance of that signature/ZIP64 format and all installed file bytes. It does not test application activation, game rendering, or Xbox hardware.
